604:t_2:9.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「In this multiverse, the government of the $$宇宙世紀$$ world is the foundation of the current $$地球連邦$$ government, and has greatly influenced its nature.」

604:t_2:10.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Therefore, I believe all of you are familiar with the monument inscribed with the $$宇宙世紀$$ Charter.」

604:t_2:11.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「However, that monument is an intentionally distorted replica, and the original monument was kept hidden for a long time.」

604:t_3:3.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「...What is being projected behind me now is the true $$宇宙世紀$$ Charter that was supposed to be made public at $$ラプラス$$.」

604:t_3:4.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Please look at its final part. This one chapter is written only in the true $$宇宙世紀$$ Charter.」

604:t_3:5.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「...'Should the emergence of a new humanity adapted to space be recognized, such persons shall be given priority in taking part in the administration of government'...」

604:t_3:6.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「In the $$宇宙世紀$$ world, it was more than 40 years after this Charter was made that $$ジオン・ダイクン$$ put forward the $$ニュータイプ$$ theory.」

604:t_3:7.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「This passage, buried along with the $$ラプラス事件$$, was probably a prayer offered to the distant future.」

604:t_3:8.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「But as time passed, it turned into a curse.」

604:t_3:9.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「What would happen if this passage were linked to $$ジオン$$'s $$ニュータイプ$$ theory and stirred up the Spacenoids' independence movement...」

604:t_3:10.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「The monument, which at first only told the truth of the $$ラプラス事件$$, became from then on an object of fear that could overthrow the $$連邦政府$$.」

604:t_3:11.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「This fact is bound to have no small influence on the multiverse as well.」

604:t_3:12.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「In the various parallel worlds that make up this world, the conflict between Earthnoids and Spacenoids has continued.」

604:t_3:13.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「That this was the intent of a certain organization is something I should not speak of here...」

604:t_3:14.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「But by rights, the prayer offered when humanity made space its place to live should have allowed such wars to be avoided.」

604:t_3:15.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「...You are free to take this fact as the scandal of one parallel world, and judge it unrelated to this world's $$連邦政府$$, whose regime has already collapsed.」

604:t_3:16.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「But this much, I want all of you to know. That many lives were lost in a war that by rights should never have happened...」

604:t_3:17.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「And I want to think together with all of you about how the world from now on ought to be.」

604:t_3:18.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「To everyone listening to this broadcast... My talk ends here, but not all of the truth has been revealed yet.」

604:t_3:19.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「From here on... even I do not know what will happen.」

604:t_3:20.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「But that is what those before us entrusted to us who live now... in other words, the future.」

604:t_3:21.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Please, all of you, join me in discerning the truth.」

604:t_3:22.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「As those before us did, I ask that you look ahead to the next era with goodwill and hope.」

604:t_3:23.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Believing in the god called possibility that sleeps within us all...」

604:t_4:7.en:
$$宗介$$
「If you've got time to talk nonsense, activate your $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ too!」

604:t_4:8.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「I can't keep up with rewriting the Physical Reactor!」

604:t_4:9.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$ノノ$$! This is exactly when you need hard work and guts!!」

604:t_4:11.en:
$n
「So you've started to value your life, $$アムブリエル$$! Saving you was worth it after all!」

604:t_4:13.en:
$n
「Everybody wants to live! You, and Miss $$スズネ$$ too!」

604:t_4:15.en:
$n
「That's why I... I'll save both Miss $$スズネ$$ and you! Which of you is the real one, and which one lives, is for Miss $$スズネ$$ and you to decide!」

604:t_4:16.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Futile...! That woman has already vanished...」

604:t_4:17.en:
$n
「Don't think a bluff will work inside this psycho-field!」

604:t_4:18.en:
$n
「Hang in there, Miss $$スズネ$$! Don't lose to someone like this!」

604:t_4:19.en:
$n
「You can hear my voice, can't you! Then come back! I need you, Miss $$スズネ$$!!」

604:t_4:21.en:
$n
「Miss $$スズネ$$! I... I'll protect you, Miss $$スズネ$$! I swear I'll protect you!!」

604:t_4:24.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「...It seems I really have lost...」

604:t_4:26.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Believe, $$バナージ$$! The possibility inside you... the future!」

604:t_4:27.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Or will you give up, knowing this light of hatred and a future of despair are waiting!」

604:t_4:33.en:
$$マリーダ$$
(What you can't see right now, I can see...)

604:t_4:34.en:
$$マリーダ$$
(Even time itself looks radiant here... Light is born even in the depths of despair...)

604:t_4:35.en:
$$マリーダ$$
(You are the light... Make even sorrow your sustenance, and light the way... with the Princess... and your comrades...)

604:t_4:36.en:
$$マリーダ$$
(Humanity is standing in the doorway now... Someday, perhaps, a time will come when we can pass through it with our bodies intact...)

604:t_4:37.en:
$$マリーダ$$
(Beyond this rainbow... the path continues...)

604:t_4:45.en:
$$カーディアス$$
(Go forth, into the future)

604:t_5:3.en:
$$エルガン#keyword$$
「...To all of you watching this broadcast. My name is $$エルガン・ローディック$$... I am from the $$ＡＤＷ$$.」

604:t_5:4.en:
$$エルガン#keyword$$
「This broadcast was prepared in advance by my comrades and me, to be made public when humanity reached the turning point of walking into a new era in the multiverse.」

604:t_5:5.en:
$$エルガン#keyword$$
「The $$ラプラスの箱$$ born from the $$ラプラス事件$$ that took place in the $$宇宙世紀$$ world that made up the $$ＵＣＷ$$...」

604:t_5:6.en:
$$エルガン#keyword$$
「We believe that now, the moment when that secret has been revealed, is the fitting opportunity.」

604:t_5:7.en:
$$エルガン#keyword$$
「...Some of you may already know this, but in each of the various parallel worlds that make up the multiverse, there exists an organization called $$クロノ$$.」

604:t_5:8.en:
$$エルガン#keyword$$
「They style themselves watchers of humanity's evolution, and have manipulated human history from the shadows.」

604:t_5:9.en:
$$エルガン#keyword$$
「The foremost example is the oppression of the Spacenoids... in other words, of the space emigrants.」

604:t_5:10.en:
$$エルガン#keyword$$
「For what purpose, in the end...? ...The answer is that they feared humanity evolving.」

604:t_5:11.en:
$$エルガン#keyword$$
「$$ニュータイプ$$s, $$イノベイター$$s, SEEDs... Research on humanity's new stage has been carried out in various worlds, but...」
